title: Scooter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='36' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='11' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='7' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='3' fill='#c9a27a'/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='78' r='11' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='78' r='7' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='78' r='3' fill='#c9a27a'/>

  <!-- deck / footboard -->
  <rect x='26' y='66' width='46' height='9' rx='4' fill='#ff7d3a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='67' width='42' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb27a'/>

  <!-- rear fender over wheel -->
  <path d='M16 72 Q26 58 36 72' fill='#4aa8ff'/>
  <path d='M19 70 Q26 61 33 70' fill='#a6d8ff'/>

  <!-- front fork -->
  <rect x='73' y='52' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#4aa8ff'/>

  <!-- steering column -->
  <rect x='69' y='28' width='8' height='30' rx='4' fill='#ff7d3a'/>
  <rect x='70' y='30' width='3' height='26' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb27a'/>

  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='56' y='26' width='30' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#4aa8ff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29.5' r='4' fill='#2a6fbf'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='29.5' r='4' fill='#2a6fbf'/>

  <!-- headlight / lamp -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='3' fill='#fff5b8'/>

  <!-- SCOOTER FACE on the fork/column area -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='1.4' fill='#1a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='48' r='1.4' fill='#1a3a6a'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M63 56 Q73 64 83 56' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ad5'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ad5'/>

  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M30 66 Q34 56 48 56 L52 56 Q60 56 60 66 Z' fill='#8a5cf0'/>
  <path d='M33 64 Q36 59 47 59 L51 59 Q56 59 57 64 Z' fill='#b89aff'/>
</svg>
